newsitem.title: FRANCE: Axa to keep Paribas stake - paper.
newsitem.headline: Axa to keep Paribas stake - paper.

text.p: French insurance company Axa has no plans to reduce its 10.7 percent stake in French financial holding company Cie Financiere de Paribas, afternoon daily Le Monde said on Monday.
The newspaper said that reducing the holding "is not in its (Axa's) intention" and that Axa considered the stake a strategic one.
It quoted Axa chairman Claude Bebear as saying that while Axa's stake in Paribas was an "accident of history", the two groups had developed activities in common.

"We use the services of the merchant bank while Paribas has invested in our reinsurance subsidiary. We can go further in certain activities such as life insurance or asset management," Bebear told the newspaper.
